research_question: Do the only two independently positive Candidate 15 routes—residual OI position buildup and breadth-aligned six-hour trend—retain positive economics when their previously generated family proposal streams are merged under one chronological global slot?

V26_OI_BUILDUP.note: V26 family-level chronological arbitration remains part of the frozen family policy.

V28_BREADTH_TREND.note: V28 family-level chronological arbitration and causal trailing-stop outcome remain part of the frozen family policy.

routing.same_entry_priority: V28 breadth trend before V26 OI buildup, then larger family rank, then symbol
routing.overlap: drop a proposal whose entry precedes the active proposal's recorded exit
routing.duplicate_episode: same family, symbol and entry timestamp may appear once
routing.costs: each source route already subtracts 16bp execution plus 4bp funding/impact reserve

advance_gate.final_integrated_frequency_requirement: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Only the unchanged merged route stream may advance; no threshold or route membership may be changed after this result.
decision_contract.reject: Preserve positive rare families as reusable components but do not present the merged router as a final system.
